data.body: AC amendment: When implementing _flock_write_json (making the tests pass GREEN), remove the RED marker `[test_flock_write_json_atomic_write]` from the `.test-index` entry for `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh`. The RED marker must only be present while the test is expected to fail. Verify: grep 'plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | grep -v '\[test_flock_write_json_atomic_write\]'
